record.name: Cyber Tech
record.description: Cyber Techs are specialists in cybernetic enhancements and biological-mechanical integration, using their skills to create powerful augmentations and repair cybernetic systems.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Cyber Techs specialize in cybernetic enhancements and repair.
visual_signals: Cybernetic implants visible on arms or legs
Advanced medical equipment integrated into armor

progression_tree.description: You develop a keen sense of awareness for your cybernetic systems, allowing you to more effectively repair and upgrade them. You gain proficiency in Perception or one tool of your choice.

You can now augment your cybernetic systems to enhance specific abilities. Choose one of the following augmentations and gain its benefits: Enhanced Strength, Enhanced Dexterity, or Enhanced Intelligence.

You can now integrate biological and mechanical components to enhance your abilities. Choose one of the following integrations and gain its benefits: Enhanced Endurance, Enhanced Agility, or Enhanced Intellect.
You gain a passive ability to redirect cyber-attacks, granting you advantage on all Constitution saving throws against cyber-attack effects.
You have become a master of cybernetic systems, granting you expertise in two tools or languages. Additionally, your proficiency bonus is doubled when repairing cybernetic systems.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assuming a neutral stance with legs shoulder-width apart, hands grasping energy blades attuned to my cybernetic enhancements.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surging blue energy tendrils emanating from my cybernetic implants, pulsing in sync with the hum of my suit's power core.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Cyber Tech standing amidst a holographic display projecting schematics and technical readouts for a damaged cyberdeck.
contextual_modifiers: Focus on the subtle details of cybernetic integration
Highlight the contrast between the dark, metallic surfaces and the bright, pulsing energy signatures
